steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Establish the exact application name 'Expense Tracker Pro' and the package hierarchy 'com.expensetrackerpro.app' within app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Build Configuration
steps.description: Establish compileSdkVersion 34, minSdkVersion 21, and configure target environments using pure Java standards compatible with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Establish Android Application Manifest
steps.description: Construct the main AndroidManifest.xml specifying single-task launch actions, permissions, themes, and correct launcher activity declarations.

steps.title: Design Style & Color Resources
steps.description: Create a unified modern, professional dark/light themed color palette and set custom resource strings.

steps.title: Implement Custom UI Drawables
steps.description: Build high-quality vector-like rounded shapes, button selectors, input backgrounds, and card layouts using standard XML drawables for modern visual styling.

steps.title: Build Data Model Class
steps.description: Program Transaction.java to represent financial records with identifier, label, amount, category, date, and flag for classification (Income vs. Expense).

steps.title: Create SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Construct DatabaseHelper.java to manage database creation, schema design, record insertion, query filters, update transactions, and monthly analytical queries.

steps.title: Design List Row Templates
steps.description: Design modular XML files for displaying individual transactional records and dynamic monthly analytical breakdown indicators.

steps.title: Construct Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Engineer a gorgeous responsive master interface (activity_main.xml) supporting beautiful headers, a sliding transaction history panel, input forms, and reports.

steps.title: Program Dynamic View Controller Logic
steps.description: Code MainActivity.java with robust business logic, form field verification, tab switches, dynamic list generation, and monthly breakdown calculation.

steps.title: Verification & Code Sanitization
steps.description: Review codebase structure to ensure compatibility with strict Java 8 features (excluding lambda syntax) and verify layout boundaries.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Execute compilation and package verification with debug signature configuration.
